facilities maintenance tickets. Each row represents a facilities service ticket submitted by building occupants and routed to internal crews or external vendors. Facilities managers and finance teams use this data to track response and resolution performance against SLA targets, monitor vendor spending, and understand which buildings and categories generate the most work. Priority and status drive escalation and staffing decisions.
Likely metrics: mean time to resolution by priority; SLA compliance rate; maintenance cost per building; ticket volume by category; open backlog by status
